figure: Figure 26 -- medspaCy/UMLS/ConText + number-context checker TP/FN by corruption type
source: Logs/evaluate_MedspacyUmlsNumberChecker_full57_20260912_064405.json, by_detail_type block (full 57-file run of Modules/medspacy_umls_number_checker.py's MedspacyUmlsNumberChecker, produced by batch_runs/medspacy_umls_number_batch57.py, scored by Modules/evaluate.py against the project's hand-labelled ground truth). Same checker as Figure 25 (Modules/medspacy_umls_checker.py's MedspacyUmlsChecker) plus one added deterministic judgment: a number+context extractor/matcher that flags a SOAP-note number as a hallucination UNLESS a context-matching transcript number is found stating the identical value (flag-by-default: a number with no transcript anchor at all, or only a thin/no context match, is flagged too, not silently skipped) -- see that module's docstring for the full mechanism, the flag-by-default policy and its precision/recall trade-off, and the dataset facts that motivated it (zero of the 57 cleaned transcripts contain a digit character at all; most number edits have no transcript anchor in any form).
description: TP/FN per injected corruption type, using the same 6 detail_type categories and display labels as Figure 4 (left) / Figure 25. detail_type is label metadata carried only by a matched ground-truth item (Modules/evaluate.py), so a false positive -- a flag with no matching label -- cannot be attributed to a corruption type; total_fp is the combined-direction overall count (hallucination + omission + status_flip), matching the scope of by_detail_type itself, not a single-direction figure.
